title: Late return rate by tier
statementMd:
For each member tier show the percentage of returned loans that were late, rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `tier`, `late_pct`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Average a 0/1 flag over returned loans.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.tier, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.return_date > l.due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.id = l.member_id WHERE l.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.tier;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
